prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a FOUR COLORWAY comparison board for the approved CLEAN TUNER guitar UI in the reference image. Use ONLY the LEFT GUITAR screen as the structural master, NOT the ukulele. Show FOUR identical tall guitar screens in a single horizontal row on a neutral light grey studio backdrop, wide landscape high resolution. Large enough to clearly compare colors and read note labels. Exact matching size, layout, typography, headstock shape, string routes, controls and readings in all four. Color/material study ONLY. Exterior small captions above each panel "01 / ALLOY", "02 / SAGE", "03 / SLATE", "04 / GRAPHITE". Minimal board margins, no extra swatches or explanatory prose.

Maintain the reference design: clean subtly frosted shell with fine edge, single inset faceplate, CLEAN TUNER top, tiny gear, Guitar / Standard selector, translucent upward three-zone note range arc labeled G♯ / A₂ / A♯, short actual-pitch marker slightly left of apex, -8 ct FLAT, AUTO, geometric flat guitar headstock outline with clipped upper corners and small circle peg touch pads, six correctly labeled pegs, Listening status and A4 440 Hz footer. Modern premium precision music device, understated teenage engineering-inspired restraint. Keep all instruments flat graphic, not chrome photoreal objects. No extra controls.

Four DISTINCT art-directed palettes:
01 ALLOY: outer shell medium-light cool brushed silver grey #C8CCCE, inset display light neutral chalk #ECEEEB, headstock muted silver #C4C9C8, typography near-black #202626. Accent vivid VERMILION ORANGE #ED512C. Silver shell must visibly contrast with lighter faceplate; bolder contrast than previous all-white. Orange only selected peg/string, pitch marker/local glow, tiny status.
02 SAGE: outer shell desaturated grey-sage #87988A, inset faceplate warm porcelain #EEEEE5, headstock pale sage #CED5C8, ink deep forest-charcoal #293C33. Selected pad cream-white #FFF3D4 with a dark olive border, selected string and pitch indicator warm deeper olive #62734C, a delicate ivory luminous halo. Calm architectural sage and cream, not pastel mint, not vintage wood. Small status light soft cream; keep sufficient visibility.
03 SLATE: outer shell muted blue slate #687C8B, inset display very dark blue-grey #253640, headstock a slightly lighter matte slate #3C515E, text soft cool white #EDF2F0, line art pale grey-blue. Accent pale ICE CYAN #95E0EB. Selected circular pad cyan, current string and short pitch marker cyan, soft limited cyan glow. Sophisticated night instrument, NOT gaming neon. Inactive note zones muted slate, preserve readable flat instrument.
04 GRAPHITE: outer shell dark warm graphite #393C39, inset display charcoal #232725, headstock medium dark grey #3C423E, text creamy ivory #E7E7D9, fine instrument outline pale grey. Accent warm AMBER #F6B953. Selected pad amber, pitch marker and one selected string amber. Quiet premium studio gear, no gold trim and no leather. Inactive arc zones subtle grey.

All four EXACT same selected guitar string A₂ number5 middle-left. Left peg labels top-to-bottom 4 D₃, 5 A₂, 6 E₂; right peg labels top-to-bottom 3 G₃, 2 B₃, 1 E₄. Exactly six string paths from nut in order left-to-right E₂ A₂ D₃ G₃ B₃ E₄. ONLY middle-left post, its circle pad and second-from-left string are accented. Top-left D3 string must stay neutral. All four show same -8 ct state. Do not change layout or add big buttons or glow everywhere. Extremely fine matte surface detail, soft shadows, controlled tonal depth, no overly thick bevels. Original Clean design, no brand logos except CLEAN TUNER.
